text.default: Architected a layout-agnostic AI put-away engine ingesting each site's shelf coordinates, dimensions, and operating rules, letting one model adapt to any STMicroelectronics warehouse floor plan without per-site rework.

Designed a 4-stage shelf-ranking pipeline: movement profiling from pick frequency, dwell time, and demand; filtering on packaging zone, fit, capacity, and restricted areas; Golden Region priority for fast movers; and logged rationale per decision.

Defined a historical-replay evaluation comparing 3 metrics against current allocation (travel distance per order, handling time, slow-mover Golden Region occupancy), piloting on 2 AMK warehouses: dice and finished goods.

entries.role: Global Data Engineer (Operational AI Systems), Part-Time

text.default: Developed ADAM, an offline tool-calling assistant on a locally hosted Gemma 4 E4B model (llama.cpp) answering spray-dryer setpoint, process, and signal questions for 6 dryers across 4 global sites, giving engineers self-serve answers to decisions previously requiring APC specialists, with rollout to Abbott servers scheduled.

Converted 4 sites' Advanced Process Control master files from Excel into 7 steady-state gain models solved as HiGHS linear programs and SLSQP tracking QPs, returning setpoints, binding constraints, and shadow prices in milliseconds across 5 modes: APC replica, single-setpoint push, CV targeting, what-if limit reports, and operator what-ifs.
text.deep: Converted 4 sites' vendor Advanced Process Control steady-state models from their Excel master files into 7 steady-state gain models solved as HiGHS linear programs (scipy.optimize.linprog) and SLSQP tracking QPs with a PLC predictor, returning setpoints, binding constraints, shadow prices, and trust-region warnings in milliseconds across 5 modes with no commercial solver license, back-tested against the production system's own historical targets.

text.default: Implemented minimum lexicographic constraint relaxation with one LP per candidate, replacing a reference simulator's bisection search, and fixed 2 defects in its quadratic program: a tolerance-band penalty applied to measured rather than predicted values, and an out-of-bounds start point.

Validated replica outputs against live APC setpoints, matching move direction in 83% of cases and temperature setpoints within 0.12 °C over 24 readings, after tracing a tag-mapping bug pairing one dryer with a second dryer's Seeq tags.

Qualified each operating point from read-only Seeq pulls via plant-state classification and 30-minute steadiness checks before any solve, and kept LLM output free of computed numbers through JSON-schema-constrained tool calls and automatic checks of each narration against solver results.

Built a Seeq signal-analytics toolkit (Kalman smoothing, Welch spectra, lag and coherence, PELT change points, matrix-profile motifs and discords, an 18-feature fingerprint) and a 5-stage offline handbook RAG pipeline: GPU OCR and layout parsing, recursive chunking, ONNX embeddings, a Chroma vector store, and LangChain retrieval.
text.deep: Built a Seeq signal-analytics toolkit (Kalman smoothing, Welch spectra, lag and coherence, PELT change points via ruptures, matrix-profile motifs and discords via STUMPY, an 18-feature fingerprint) and a 5-stage offline handbook RAG pipeline: GPU OCR and layout parsing (marker, PyTorch/CUDA), recursive chunking (chonkie), bge-small ONNX embeddings (fastembed), a Chroma vector store with top-k similarity ranking, and LangChain retrieval over Gemma 4 E4B served through llama.cpp GGUF.

text.default: Proved production modules identical to research notebooks with exact-equality parity tests, alongside 20 engine tests, HTTP contract tests, a headless notebook runner, and a deterministic model stand-in for GPU-free CI.
Delivered AI-enabled systems and data workflows for process improvement, manufacturing analytics, operational decision support, and supply-chain automation.
Strengthened monitoring and process structure across healthcare supply chains with AI, protecting product availability for vulnerable patient groups.

Built a live multi-site data layer over read-only Seeq historian pulls, with per-site mapping driven by configuration rather than forks and automated operating-window qualification excluding downtime.
text.deep: Built a live multi-site data layer over read-only Seeq (SPy) historian pulls, mapping each site through configuration rather than forks (status predicates, production thresholds, time zones, tag mapping, unit overrides), with automated operating-window qualification excluding downtime, then Kalman smoothing, Welch PSD, lag and coherence, change-point detection (ruptures), and matrix-profile motifs (STUMPY) in SciPy and pandas.

text.default: Hardened global deployment with lock-pinned CUDA and CPU builds, OS trust-store integration for enterprise TLS-inspecting proxies, and an auditable decision register for every deviation from the vendor reference.

Developed a SimPy discrete-event digital twin and OR-Tools CP-SAT solver for hybrid flow-shop scheduling, then compared 3 approaches (heuristic, MIP, and genetic algorithm) to turn production objectives and constraints into decision-ready schedules.
text.deep: Developed a SimPy discrete-event digital twin and OR-Tools CP-SAT solver for hybrid flow-shop scheduling over interval and precedence constraints, then compared 3 approaches (heuristic, MIP, and genetic algorithm) against heuristic baselines and researched robust optimization for operational uncertainty.

text.default: Validated a non-destructive, 15-stage changeover-data pipeline against 5 years of unseen raw data with zero execution failures across operator- and machine-generated anomalies.
text.deep: Validated a non-destructive, 15-stage changeover-data pipeline over operational matrices that encoded meaning in values, labels, colours, merged regions, and blanks, using controlled staging sheets, repair passes, From-To edge-list conversion, correction tables, audit outputs, and explicit exception handling to expose every intermediate state instead of mutating source data, against 5 years of unseen raw data with zero execution failures.

text.default: Deployed a team-built APC simulator to production for live internal users on Azure App Service, with Docker packaging, access restrictions, and runtime and session hardening.
text.solution-architect: Owned cloud deployment and production support for a team-built APC simulator used in manufacturing and engineer training, with Docker packaging, Azure App Service hosting, and documented handover.
text.deep: Productionized a team-built Advanced Process Control simulator for live internal users on Azure App Service, handling Flask and JavaScript debugging, Docker packaging, session and request tracking, access restrictions, and documented deployment handover, with the originating team retaining authorship.

text.default: Trained regional engineering teams across Asia and Europe on repeatable AI workflows spanning 7 areas: prompting, model selection, benchmarks, cost awareness, agents, validation, and safeguards.

Strengthened Excel, VBA, Python, master-data, and scheduling workflows with 3 safeguards: validation rules, correction tables, and reproducible intermediate stages, leaving every transformation auditable.
Documented deployment, access provisioning, and technical handover across 3 procedures, so internal manufacturing and engineer-training users stayed supported after transfer to owning teams.

Recruited into PA's Sparks Citizens Developer network as a community innovator in recognition of prior public-good initiatives, then designed, built, and deployed Churp, a resident-driven garden-plot balloting platform now live in Tengah and slated for national rollout, seeded by a S$20K Sparks Community Innovation Fund award.

text.deep: Owned most software development and deployment across admin and public Next.js frontends, a NestJS backend, and GIS-based plot allocation, coordinating stakeholders and rollout planning across product, engineering, and operations.
